name: Lantern Forest
description: Glowing fruits resembling little lanterns hang from the branches of old spruce trees.

scenes.name: Glowing Path
scenes.description: Fallen needles shimmer underfoot, forming a winding path.

scenes.name: Hollow of an Old Spruce
scenes.description: Warm light pours from a deep hollow, although no fire or lamp is visible inside.

scenes.name: Night Moth Glade
scenes.description: Large silvery moths circle slowly among the glowing fruits.
